scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter niceeval run typecheck && pnpm --filter niceeval exec tsc -p ../../docs/feature/assertions/reference/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: pnpm run docs:mint && concurrently --names vitest,validate,links "pnpm run lint:vitest" "pnpm run docs:validate" "pnpm run docs:links"
scripts.lint:docs-site: pnpm run docs:mint && concurrently --names vitest,validate,links "vitest run --project lint-docs-site" "pnpm run docs:validate" "pnpm run docs:links"
scripts.site:dev: pnpm --filter niceeval run build:package && pnpm --filter @niceeval/site run dev
scripts.site:build: pnpm --filter niceeval run build:package && pnpm --filter @niceeval/site run build && tsx scripts/submit-indexnow.ts
